LESSON: SONGS PERFORMING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Songs PERFORMING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Songs PERFORMING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. sing a variety of age appropriate songs in unison paying attention to accuracy in pitch and rhythm for enjoyment,
2. sing 2-part rounds for enjoyment,

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Songs PERFORMING.
2. Explain Songs PERFORMING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Songs PERFORMING.
4. Show that you can: sing a variety of age appropriate songs in unison paying attention to accuracy in pitch and rhythm for enjoyment,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Songs PERFORMING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
